$comment: Structured encoding of the SAPRF v1.4 Centrefire (PRS) selection document (verbatim source: docs/selection/prs/2026/policy.md). This is the PRS Centerfire discipline for the IPRF World Championships 2026 - NOT PR22 (rimfire). Rule IDs and thresholds match the audit trail written to selection_rule_evaluations. If the two ever diverge, the .md file is authoritative and this file must be corrected.

governing_document.title: SAPRF Team South Africa - Selection Process

rules.text: Be a paid-up Member of SAPRF in good standing
Reside within the Province to which they are affiliated
Reside within South Africa. Exception: SA citizens residing abroad who shot the SAPRF Centrefire Championship match in 2025.
Be a member of a SAPRF recognized club to which they are affiliated
Complete the 'Eligibility to Compete' forms and such forms must have been received by the ExCo
SA Champs 2025 is mandatory; it always counts as one of the 4 required matches regardless of province
Minimum 4 counted National/International 2-day matches (SA Champs + up to 1 in-province + up to 3 out-of-province + IPRF/PRS internationals)
At least 1 counted match must fall within 3 months of the closing date of the Qualifying Period (31 Aug – 30 Nov 2025)
Only 1 in-province 2-day national match may count (SA Champs exempt)
Maximum 3 out-of-province 2-day national matches may count
Only IPRF- and PRS-sanctioned international 2-day matches may count
Athlete must be a full member of SAPRF to claim Selection Points

interpretation_notes: The source document contains a drafting tension: bullet 1 says '1 of which MUST be the SAPRF Championship match in 2025' (SA Champs = 1 of the 4), while a later bullet says 'SA Champs is mandatory and in addition to the 2 day nationals listed above'. The most internally consistent reading, and the one this policy implements, is that SA Champs IS one of the 4 minimum matches, but its province does not consume the in-province cap. If ExCo intends SA Champs to be a fifth mandatory match on top of 4 others, the min_counted_2d_matches threshold should be raised and this policy re-imported.
'Within 3 months of the closing date' is treated as match_date within the calendar 3 months preceding the qualifying_period_end (i.e. 2025-08-30 to 2025-11-30 inclusive).

PART-06 (IPRF/PRS-sanctioned international check) will report BLOCKED until the matches table carries a sanctioning_body field. Adding that field is a small follow-up migration; the evaluator will start honouring it automatically once populated.

team_quotas.note: Selectors may fill up to 2 Individual positions when a team cannot be filled. Divisions/quotas may change per IPRF directives.

appeals.grounds: The Selection Policy process was not properly followed and/or implemented

grounds: Loss of form or fitness assessed to affect performance at the Championships
Contravention of Athlete Agreement / SAPRF Rules / Code of Conduct / Constitution / Social Media Policy
